resources.title: DevOps Capstone Acceptance Rubric
resources.description: The scored, checkable version of Lesson 3's Definition of Done — 100 points across infrastructure, containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD reliability, security, observability, troubleshooting, and documentation, with real verification steps and a required 90-point pass bar. Use it to honestly self-score your finished project.

resources.title: Northbridge Architecture Reference
resources.description: Lesson 1's complete end-to-end architecture diagram and resource-naming table — every cluster, namespace, registry, Key Vault, and storage resource used throughout the capstone, in one place. Reuse the naming pattern (a consistent prefix plus an environment variable) for your own project.

resources.title: Blameless Postmortem Template
resources.description: Lesson 16's exact postmortem structure (summary, impact, timeline, root cause, contributing factor, owned and dated action items) as a reusable template, plus the specific rule the acceptance rubric enforces: every action item needs both an owner and a date.

resources.title: Security Scanning Gate Checklist
resources.description: Lesson 15's three scanners (Trivy, Checkov, gitleaks) as a quick reference, plus the real gotcha that catches people off guard: a scanner that's wired into CI but configured to only report, not block (soft_fail: true, a missing exit-code setting), protects nothing.
